mstts:express-as.prosody: Picture this: gentle green pastures stretching out under a wide sky, the sound of still waters nearby, and the quiet assurance that someone is guiding you—even when the path winds through uncertain valleys. Welcome to a journey inspired by W. Phillip Keller’s heartfelt work, A Shepherd Looks at Psalm 23. Drawing from his own hands-on experience tending sheep, Keller opens our eyes to just how deep the connection is between shepherd and flock. Suddenly, those classic words from Psalm 23 aren’t just poetry—they’re alive with meaning and comfort, inviting us to see trust, provision, and protection in an entirely new light. As we walk together through this exploration, you’ll notice how each familiar phrase is woven into the real, everyday world of a shepherd—guiding, nurturing, and sometimes rescuing sheep who rely completely on their caretaker. We’ll move from peaceful meadows to shadowy valleys, always accompanied by the watchful presence of someone who truly cares. This isn’t just a reflection on faith—it’s a chance to encounter what it really means to belong, to be guided, and to know deep down that even in the darkest times, we’re never alone. So, let’s explore these timeless words together, and see what new comfort and wisdom we might find along the way.
